title: Bukaanka
intro: Waqti hore, maalmihii ugu horreeyay ee taariikhda aadanaha, laba nafood ayaa hor taagnaa Abuurahooda iyagoo wata allabaryo. Mid waa la aqbalay, midna lama aqbalin. Wixii xigay waxay noqon doonaan masiibo weyn oo ugu horreysay oo dhex marta walaalaha - hal fal oo dulqaad leh iyo hal fal oo aargoosi qadhaadh ah. Ma ogaan kartaa qofka aan ahay?
clues: Waxaan ku dhashay maalmihii ugu horreeyay ee aadanaha uu dhulka ku noolaa
Waxaan ahaa ilmo ay dhaleen lammaanihii ugu horreeyay ee dhulkan ku noolaa
Mar ayaan allabari ka bixiyay adhigaygii ugu fiicnaa si aan u raali galiyo Abuurahaygii
Dalabkaygii kor ayaa laga aqbalay, halka walaalkay la diiday
Markii aan dil ugu hanjabay, waxaan doortay inaan gacantayda ku qaadin walaalkay
Waxaan noqday qofkii ugu horreeyay taariikhda aadanaha oo dhan oo si khaldan loogu dilay qof kale

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Allabariga Ismaaciil ee uu sameeyay Ibraahim

location.label: Qaybta Muhiimka ah
options: Shimbir hoopoe ah oo sidda farriin boqornimo

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Wuxuu noqday dhibbanihii ugu horreeyay ee dil loo geysto taariikhda aadanaha
Waxaan ka badbaaday daad weyn oo gudaha weel alwaax ah ku jiray
Wuxuu xukumay jinni, aadane, iyo dabaysha
Afartan sano oo aan ku dhex wareegayay lamadegaanka weyn
outcome.answer: Wuxuu noqday dhibbanihii ugu horreeyay ee dil loo geysto taariikhda aadanaha

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
